info.name: Project API — Web
info.description:
Complete Shielder backend API collection for Web, Admin, and Superadmin clients.

All routes are also available under `/api/v1/*` (same handlers).

Locale: `Accept-Language: en|ar`.
Auth tokens are saved automatically from login responses at `data.tokens.accessToken` (refresh at `data.accessToken` for `/auth/refresh`).

Generated from backend route source. Legacy root collections are preserved.

item.description: Private signed URL streaming. Token is a JWT signed with PRIVATE_URL_SIGNING_SECRET. No Bearer auth.

request.description:
Streams a private object (profile/contact uploads only). Authorization is the signed `:token` path parameter.

- Expired → `storage.privateExpired`
- Invalid/tampered → `storage.privateInvalidToken`
- Allowed refs: `/uploads/profile/*`, `/uploads/contact/*`
- Success returns raw bytes (image/pdf), not JSON.

Never log or commit `PRIVATE_URL_SIGNING_SECRET`.

**Auth:** Public (no Bearer token)

**Locale:** Send `Accept-Language: en` or `Accept-Language: ar` (Arabic if header equals/starts with `ar`).

item.name: Inventory — Bulk Upload & Negatives
item.description: Excel bulk product upload and common negative cases. Inspect product.service bulkUpload for column rules.

request.description:
Admin multipart upload. Field name: `file`.

**Template columns:** Product Name, Arabic Name, Filter Number, Alternate Numbers, SKU, Price, Stock, Minimum Stock, Category Name, Subcategory Name, Brand Name, Description, Arabic Description, Filter Type, Material, Dimensions, Image, spec_Color, spec_Size.

**Required per row:** Product Name (or Name), Price (numeric), Stock (numeric).
SKU optional but must be unique when present.
Missing category/subcategory names are auto-created.
Image column supports data URL, HTTP(S) URL, or safe local path; embedded workbook images also supported.
Imported products are created as `PUBLISHED` (unlike normal create which is `PENDING`).
Download template via `GET /inventory/products/template`.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT required

**Required role:** `ADMIN`

**Locale:** Send `Accept-Language: en` or `Accept-Language: ar` (Arabic if header equals/starts with `ar`).

response.name: 200 Success
403 Forbidden
